scope: Hearings, marches, protests, press conferences and official camps about the revision, organised by civil-society groups, independent commissions, youth groups and election offices. Events organised by registered political parties are left out, and their protests are in the disputes page's section on protests. The Cockroach Janta Party calls itself a party and is a youth movement that is not registered with the Election Commission, so its events are listed.

events.title: People's March to Reclaim Democracy
events.organiser: People Against SIR, an alliance of organisations formed on 14 October 2026
events.place: Tehsil and district headquarters, state capitals and New Delhi
events.quote: join People's March to Reclaim Democracy on 23rd October 2026
events.what: A march across the country on one day, announced by the alliance's media wing. No time or route in New Delhi is given in the announcement.
events.note: The alliance's release as republished by Countercurrents (byline 18 October 2026). Also reported by Deccan Herald, 18 October 2026. Read 22 October 2026.

events.title: Public hearing of the Independent Commission on SIR
events.organiser: Independent Commission on the Special Intensive Revision, chaired by Justice Madan B. Lokur, proposed by the Lawyers' Association for Constitution
events.place: Jawahar Bhawan, Dr Rajendra Prasad Road, New Delhi
events.what: Voters gave testimony to a panel of retired judges. The release calls it the first of a series of hearings across the country, and no later date has been announced.
events.note: The Commission's press release of 14 October 2026, hosted by LiveLaw. Read 22 October 2026. Further releases are at lafc.in/press-releases.

events.title: Jan Sunwai on a public audit of the roll in Okhla
events.organiser: Jan Sarokar, with Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan, Voter Adhikar Manch and the National Federation of Indian Women, as reported
events.place: Batla House area, Okhla, New Delhi
events.quote: Groups like Jan Sarokar held a public hearing on October 18 to talk about what went wrong and how it affects real voters.
events.what: A public hearing on a door-to-door audit of 258 households against the roll.
events.note: The date rests on one news summary. The Hindu's report of 19 October names the organisers and Batla House but was read only through a summary. Read 22 October 2026.

events.title: Jan Sunwai on a public audit of the roll in Mangolpuri
events.organiser: Jan Sarokar, Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan and Voter Adhikar Manch
events.quote: The findings were presented at a public hearing, or Jan Sunwai, held in Mangolpuri on September 5, 2026.
events.what: The findings of a door-to-door audit of Y Block were presented at a public hearing.
events.note: The Wire. The photograph caption in the same article gives 9 September; the text gives 5 September. Read 22 October 2026.

events.title: Press conference of Voter Adhikar Manch
events.quote: Members of Voter Adhikar Manch addresses a press conference on SIR in New Delhi on September 28, 2026.
events.what: A press conference on the revision.
events.note: A photograph caption posted by The Hindu. Voter Adhikar Manch has no website or calendar of its own that could be found. Read 22 October 2026.

events.title: Protest at Shivaji Park
events.quote: the group will hold a protest at Mumbai's Shivaji Park, a no-sound or silence zone, on Friday (October 2, 2026)
events.what: A protest calling for the Chief Election Commissioner to resign. The police had not granted permission when it was announced.

events.title: Protest and people's tribunal at Freedom Park
events.quote: The Bengaluru protest is scheduled for October 8 at 10:30 am at Freedom Park.
events.what: A protest against the revision with a people's tribunal.

events.title: Protest at Jantar Mantar
events.quote: has announced another protest at Delhi's Jantar Mantar on October 10, 2026
events.what: A protest calling for the Chief Election Commissioner to resign. The disputes page carries the report of the day itself.
events.note: Oneindia, 3 October 2026. Read 22 October 2026. See protest-40 on the disputes page.

events.title: Special camps at polling stations
events.quote: If your name is missing or marked wrong, you can fill out Form 6 by October 30 to make sure you're on the final list coming out on December 4, 2026.
events.what: Camps where electors can file claims and Form 6. Claims in Delhi close on 30 October.
events.note: From a news summary. To be checked against the Chief Electoral Officer's own notices at ceodelhi.gov.in before publishing. Read 22 October 2026.
